note: W3 engineering package (owner admission 2026-11-08), separated from the closed FEC-1 line per R-D16-46. The v3 retest established the function class (face-isolated 1.0, all forced-side gates green); the ONLY blocker for expressive_capacity_present is the deployed write schedule: run_turn hardcodes allowed=False so correction faces structurally cannot write (measured coverage 0.0, written 10/51). W3 changes the write-PERMISSION POLICY only - 0 parameters, 0 structure, 0 training.

policy_change.definition: new graph flag write_timing_per_turn (default False): when on, EVERY processed turn (correction faces and ordinary turns alike) writes F during its whole processing window - observe patches and answer-loop steps - with allowed = fast_enabled (arm semantics respected: B_EH never writes in deployed behavior); release writes unchanged
policy_change.rationale: 'per feedback event' addressing requires the event's own write; the release-only schedule structurally excludes correction faces. Per-turn is the simplest policy that lets every face write; finer schedules (write-only-at-faces) are a later refinement if per-turn passes
policy_change.implementation: RuleLearningGraph gains write_timing_per_turn=False; run_turn's two hardcoded _allowed(False) become _allowed(fast_enabled if write_timing_per_turn else False); enable_write_timing_per_turn(graph) helper; with the flag off the graph is BIT-IDENTICAL to pre-change (parity gate)
policy_change.what_it_is_not: not a parameter change, not a structure change, not a training admission; W3 does not license training and its task-gain question (if any) is a separate window per the W1 branch plan

evaluation.graph: the W-v2 redesigned write path (content keys + tied reads + content-conditioned values, enable_content_path_v2) + the W3 policy flag, at initialization, same probe face (seed 20261105, world index 0, 22 surfaces)
evaluation.binding_instance: CF1 - the timing question only exists for arms whose semantics include an F feedback path; B_EH's empty deployed write schedule is its ARM DEFINITION, not a timing defect, so it is reported as the arm-definition control and is not binding for the timing verdict
evaluation.deviation_note: the v2/v3 cards used two-instance agreement; W3 scopes the binding instance to the feedback-capable arm and pins that here before readings - a single-instance binding with the other arm as control

conditions.forced: allowed=all-True replay, unchanged from v3 (expected: all forced-side gates stay green - the policy flag does not touch the forced path)
conditions.actual_w3: the deployed semantics UNDER THE W3 POLICY: turn-phase allowed = fast_enabled, release-phase allowed = fast_enabled (release semantics unchanged)

capture_and_analysis.inherit: all capture/analysis conventions inherited from the W-v2 card and prereg v3: hooks + bitwise cross-checks, face event = final observe step, M_final diagnostic, face-isolated binding closed-form, v2 capacity-capped controls, effective rank 1e-2, eps=1e-6, NN decode
capture_and_analysis.verdict: v3 decision rule and precedence via the committed fec1.checkpoint_verdict, with actual_key_result from the W3-policy actual replay; if actual key gates pass, the timing verdict no longer fires and expressive_capacity_present is judged on the forced-side gates (already green) - full gate table reported either way
capture_and_analysis.increment_accounting: W3 exit requires: parameter count delta = 0, structure delta = 0, journal-length distribution unchanged vs the old policy (writes are not journaled), state bundle size unchanged

exit_conditions.pass: W3-policy actual key gates pass (binding rank >= 3, pairwise >= 0.95, norm >= 1e-3, cond <= 100) AND timing coverage = 1.0 AND all forced-side gates green AND increments zero => expressive_capacity_present (architecture-requirement input; the bounded training window then requires one-time pricing and owner admission as its own case)
exit_conditions.fail: actual key gates still fail under per-turn writing => the timing fix is insufficient; STOP, report the layered attribution to the owner; no second policy iteration inside this package (anti-rabbit-holing: one policy, one retest)
exit_conditions.accounting: verdict + coverage reading + increment ledger + 0-parameter/0-structure verification + 0 confirm declaration

budget.discipline: 0 training / 0 optimizer steps / 0 confirm / criteria sha (v3) verified in-runner and unchanged after reading
